messages.content: Let's finish San Diego tonight. Book the selected nonstop flights, both hotels, and the Friday-to-Monday rental, then give me one itinerary with every charge and deadline.

Before I submit anything, I need to reconcile one change: the last plan replaced the rental with rideshares for the whole stay, but you are now asking for a three-day rental. Should I restore the rental from Friday arrival through Monday and return it downtown before the Little Italy check-in?
Yes, restore it. Pick it up at SAN after we land Friday and return it downtown Monday morning. After that we'll use rideshare, including to the airport Wednesday.

Understood. The rental, La Jolla parking, fuel, and post-return rideshares are projected together at $434. The vehicle itself will be reserved Friday at SAN through Monday downtown. I also need the passenger and guest names exactly as shown on identification.
Maya Chen and Jordan Lee. Use Maya Chen as the primary hotel guest and rental driver. Jordan is the second airline passenger and hotel guest. No second driver.

I have the Friday MSP-SAN nonstop departing 9:20 a.m. and arriving 11:15 a.m., plus the Wednesday SAN-MSP nonstop departing 5:35 p.m. and arriving 11:05 p.m. The fare is still available at $1,142 total for two travelers in economy. Checked bags are not included and remain an estimated $140 total if each of you checks one bag each way. Shall I ticket both travelers now?
Yes, ticket both. The fare expires tonight, so do that first.

The flights are ticketed for Maya Chen and Jordan Lee. The card charge is $1,142, and the airline confirmation is SD4K9Q. Standard ticket rules apply to later voluntary changes; checked bags have not been purchased. I am moving to the La Jolla hotel for Friday, October 4 through Monday, October 7, 2030.
Go ahead. Please verify the total and refundable deadline before confirming it.

The selected La Jolla room is available for three nights. The final room-and-tax estimate is $1,178.40; parking is excluded from that hotel amount because it is already carried in the $434 transportation projection. The reservation is refundable if canceled by 6:00 p.m. Pacific on Friday, September 27. After that, the hotel may charge one night's room and tax. No deposit is due now; a card guarantee is required. Confirm?
Confirm it under my name.

La Jolla is confirmed for Maya Chen, with Jordan Lee listed as the second guest. Check-in is Friday, October 4 and checkout is Monday, October 7. The hotel confirmation is LJ730184. Estimated payment at the property is $1,178.40, and the cancellation deadline is September 27 at 6:00 p.m. Pacific.
Now book Little Italy for Monday through Wednesday. Make sure the deposit and the 72-hour cutoff are recorded correctly.

The Little Italy room is available for October 7 through October 9. The two-night total is $725.60 including estimated tax. A one-night deposit of $362.80 is charged at booking, with the remaining estimated $362.80 due at the hotel. Free cancellation ends at 4:00 p.m. Pacific on Friday, October 4, exactly 72 hours before the stated 4:00 p.m. check-in. A cancellation after that point may forfeit the deposit. Should I confirm it?
Yes. Also ask them to hold both suitcases Monday from about 10:30 until the room is ready.

Little Italy is confirmed under Maya Chen with Jordan Lee added. Confirmation: LI492706. The $362.80 deposit has been charged, the estimated balance is $362.80, and the cancellation deadline is October 4 at 4:00 p.m. Pacific. The hotel has also confirmed complimentary luggage storage for two suitcases on Monday beginning around 10:30 a.m.; you can collect them when the room is ready.
Good. Reserve the car next. Compact is fine, pickup at the airport after the 11:15 arrival and downtown return Monday before we take the bags to the hotel.

A compact automatic is available at SAN from Friday, October 4 at 12:15 p.m. until Monday, October 7 at 9:30 a.m., returning to the downtown location. The rental estimate is $284 including taxes and standard facility charges, with no second driver. It is pay at pickup, has no prepaid deposit, and can be canceled without charge through the scheduled pickup time. Fuel, La Jolla parking, and rideshares after the return remain estimates within the combined $434 transportation projection. Confirm the reservation?
Confirm it. Is the downtown office open early enough on Monday?

Confirmed under Maya Chen, reference RC61835. The downtown office opens at 8:00 a.m. Monday, so the 9:30 a.m. return is within operating hours. The reservation shows SAN pickup and downtown return, and there is no one-way fee in the quoted $284 estimate.
Put the whole Friday-to-Wednesday schedule together. Keep airfare, lodging, bags, and transportation distinct, but give me one projected total too.

Friday, October 4: depart MSP at 9:20 a.m., arrive SAN at 11:15 a.m., pick up the compact car at 12:15 p.m., then check into La Jolla for three nights. Monday, October 7: check out, return the car downtown by 9:30 a.m., take both suitcases to the Little Italy hotel around 10:30 a.m., and leave them with the confirmed luggage desk until the room is ready. Stay in Little Italy Monday and Tuesday nights. Wednesday, October 9: check out, retain the bags with the hotel if needed, request an airport rideshare around 2:30 p.m., depart SAN nonstop at 5:35 p.m., and arrive MSP at 11:05 p.m.
And the reconciliation? I want to know what was actually charged now versus what is still projected.

Charged now: $1,142 for airfare and $362.80 for the Little Italy deposit, totaling $1,504.80. Guaranteed but not charged now: La Jolla at an estimated $1,178.40. Estimated balance due in Little Italy: $362.80. Transportation is projected at $434 total, consisting of the $284 rental estimate plus approximately $150 for fuel, La Jolla parking, and rideshares after Monday. Lodging totals $1,904.00. The trip projection is $3,480.00 before checked bags: $1,142 airfare, $1,904 lodging, and $434 transportation. Adding the separate $140 checked-bag estimate produces a projected all-in total of $3,620.00. Confirmations are SD4K9Q for flights, LJ730184 for La Jolla, LI492706 for Little Italy, and RC61835 for the rental. Cancellation cutoffs are September 27 at 6:00 p.m. Pacific for La Jolla, October 4 at 4:00 p.m. Pacific for Little Italy, and the scheduled October 4 pickup time for the rental. Monday luggage storage for two suitcases is confirmed.
